-警告：具有挑战性的起源
这个文明曾被一个异星帝国造访过，这个帝国强行启蒙了他们，之后奴役了他们。如今他们击退了入侵者，但那些入侵者有朝一日还会回来吗？
excerpt.en: This civilization has been visited by an alien empire who forcibly enlightened and enslaved them. They have repelled their invaders, but will they return?

texts.zh:
-警告：具有挑战性的起源
这个文明曾被一个异星帝国造访过，这个帝国强行启蒙了他们，之后奴役了他们。如今他们击退了入侵者，但那些入侵者有朝一日还会回来吗？
texts.en: This civilization has been visited by an alien empire who forcibly enlightened and enslaved them. They have repelled their invaders, but will they return?

sections.zh:
我们曾经做过一个交易。

当来自外部星辰的访客显露身形时，他们向我们提供了一份公平的合同：技术启蒙，分期偿还。在一代人的时间里，我们的行星被转变成为了一个所谓的“先进文明”。

然后我们才了解到小字条款：为了偿还我们的“债务”，他们坚持要我们为他们劳作，而且是无限期的。我们的领袖对此反对，但这些外来者马上翻脸动用了暴力。我们奋起反抗。

我们赢了，但是赢得十分艰难，并且为此付出了惨烈得代价。现在，我们的科学家终于从过去我们摧毁的飞船上，通过逆向工程攻破了超光速旅行的秘密。宇宙很大，但迟早我们肯定会再次遇到我们的“恩人”。而实际上，我们也迫不及待，摩拳擦掌。

现在是时候血债血偿了。
sections.en:
We had a deal.

When the visitors from the stars revealed themselves, they offered us a fair contract: technological enlightment, to be repaid in installments. Within a generation, our planet was transformed into a so-called 'advanced civilization.'

Then we read the fine print: to repay our 'debt', they insisted we work for them, on an indefinite term. When our leaders protested, the outsiders turned violent. We fought back.

We won, though barely, and only after suffering sizeable losses. Now, our scientists have finally reverse-engineered the secrets of FTL travel from the ships we destroyed. It's a big galaxy out there, but sooner or later we're sure to meet our 'benefactors' again. In fact, we're looking forward to it.

It's time to get some payback.

texts.zh: 曾经威胁我们家园的战舰仍然高悬在头顶，严酷地提醒着我们侥幸逃脱的命运。现在该去夺回我们的天空，取回这艘舰船残骸中的高超科技了。
texts.en: The warship that once threatened our homeworld still looms over us, a stark reminder of the fate we narrowly escaped. It is time to take back our skies and salvage the technological marvels contained within the wreck.

sections.zh: 曾经威胁我们家园的战舰仍然高悬在头顶，严酷地提醒着我们侥幸逃脱的命运。现在该去夺回我们的天空，取回这艘舰船残骸中的高超科技了。
sections.en: The warship that once threatened our homeworld still looms over us, a stark reminder of the fate we narrowly escaped. It is time to take back our skies and salvage the technological marvels contained within the wreck.

texts.zh:
我们的传感器无法在废弃战舰中探测到任何生命迹象，空空如也的船舱里引擎仍在轻微地嗡嗡作响，各种机械也还在运转。有理由相信，这艘船仍可正常运转，如果强行登船肯定会激活其安保系统。

我们务必谨慎开展工作。
texts.en:
Our sensors cannot detect signs of life within the derelict warship, and yet the engines still faintly buzz and machines are at work inside the empty halls. There is good reason to believe the ship is still operational, and attempts to board it are sure to awaken its security system.

We must proceed with caution.

texts.zh:
我们的施工人员正在清除碎片，修复损伤并确保舱室安全，把这艘曾经威胁我们星球的战舰变成新的行动基地。在残骸中，我们找到了越来越多的船员尸体或者残肢断臂。

如何处理这些遗体引发了公众的热议。
texts.en:
Our construction crews are clearing debris, repairing damage and securing rooms, turning the warship that once terrorized our world into a base of operations. Amidst the wreckage, we have uncovered the bodies of the ship's crew, or rather, what's left of them.

What to do with these remains is a matter of public debate.

label.zh: 恶人也应该得到妥善安葬。
label.en: Even villains deserve a proper burial.

texts.zh: 当我们仔细搜索战舰的中央数据库的时候，我们逐渐搞清楚了前任主人的整个计划。他们打着启蒙的幌子接近我们，只是为了将我们训练成为更好的奴隶；他们满怀善意呈上的计划和协议，只不过是精心编织的谎言。我们的星球显然不是他们第一次这么干，而是他们核心“商业战略”的一个典范。
texts.en: As we scour the warship's central database, the designs of our former masters have grown clear. The way they approached with enlightenment, only to train us to become better slaves; their well-honed plans and protocols; their calculated lies. Our world was clearly not their first attempt, but rather an example of their core 'business strategy.'

texts.zh: 我们已经完全控制了这艘废弃战舰的系统。我们现在必须决定如何处理它。根据我们的需求，它对于战争和研究都可以成为非常有利用价值的资源。
texts.en: We have gained complete control of the derelict warship's systems. We now must decide what to do with it. Depending on our needs, it could be a powerful asset for either war or research.

tooltips.zh: 让我们可以将战舰修复成一艘旗舰或居住站。
tooltips.en: Allows us to restore the warship into either a Flagship or Habitat.

texts.zh: 前 MSI 战舰将得到修复，为我们所用。
texts.en: MSI's former warship will be restored to serve our purposes.

texts.zh:
这艘战舰将成为我们舰队的瑰宝。

这艘战舰将得到修复，变成一艘功能齐全的旗舰，能够作为一个移动船坞使用。
texts.en:
The warship will become the gem of our fleet.

The warship shall be repaired and turned into a functioning Flagship.

texts.zh:
对前弥特集团战舰进行改造的工作已经完成。现在我们能够指挥一艘具有强大火力和战略意义的舰船了。

接招吧，星辰大海！
texts.en:
The retrofit of the former MSI Warship is complete. We now have at our disposal a vessel of massive power and significance.

Watch out, galaxy!

tooltips.zh: 战舰已经修复成为了一艘旗舰，能够在[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的轨道上作为一个移动船坞。
tooltips.en: The warship in orbit of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] has been restored into a Flagship.

texts.zh:
这艘战舰经过改造之后，现在将用于科学研究。

经过修复之后，这台曾经的死亡机器现在被转变成一个功能齐全的居住站，致力于揭开弥特集团科技的秘密。
texts.en:
The warship will now be retrofitted for scientific research.

Following repairs, this former instrument of death will be fully converted into a functioning Habitat, devoted to uncovering the secrets of MSI's technology.

texts.zh: 对前弥特集团战舰进行改造的工作已经完成。现在我们拥有了最先进的科研设施，它将会为我们推进科技知识的开发提供帮助。
texts.en: The retrofit of the former MSI Warship is complete. We have now gained a state of the art science facility which will be instrumental to us in advancing our technological knowledge.

tooltips.zh: 战舰已经被修复成了一座居住站，在[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的轨道上专门攻破弥特集团科技的秘密。
tooltips.en: The warship has been restored into a Habitat, devoted to uncovering the secrets of MSI's technology, in orbit of [owner.capital_scope.GetName].

texts.zh:
一个小型的自推档案存储器刚刚进入了我们的母星系边缘，用一个信号信标大声宣告了其到来。该档案一经取得，就显示出它所包含的阴森信息：一份长长的列表，里面详细列出了在与侵略者作战期间我们摧毁的所有军事资产，包括船组人员的伤亡，以及每艘被摧毁的船只的估计价值。

我们先前的入侵者正式提出了战争赔款。更讽刺的是，他们还声称，在我们的星系中被摧毁的所有船只仍然是他们的财产，任何试图对残骸进行摧毁、改装或者逆向的行为都将会使我们违反条款。

一个债务收集机构很快将与我们联系，以便解决此事。
texts.en:
A small, self-propelled cache just entered the edges of our home system, loudly announcing its arrival with a signal beacon. Once retrieved, the cache revealed its grim contents: a lengthy list detailing all the military assets we destroyed during the war against our invaders, complete with crew casualties and the estimated value of each destroyed vessel.

Our former invaders are officially demanding war reparations. This despite the fact that they are the ones who invaded us. Even more outrageously, they also claim that all the destroyed ships in our system are still their property, and any attempt to destroy, refit or retro-engineer the wreckage will put us in breach of terms and conditions.

A debt collection agency will soon contact us to settle the matter.

tooltips.zh: 收债人将在[root.payback_debt_collectors_timer]造访我们。
tooltips.en: The debt collectors will visit us on [root.payback_debt_collectors_timer].

texts.zh:
我们的前主人声称我们亏欠他们战争赔款。他们已经雇佣了一个星际债务回收机构来处理此事。

[root.GetDebtCollectorsDeal]

收债人将在[root.payback_debt_collectors_timer]访问我们。
texts.en:
Our former masters claim we owe them war reparations. An intergalactic debt collection agency has been hired to settle the matter.

[root.GetDebtCollectorsDeal]

The debt collectors will visit us on [root.payback_debt_collectors_timer]

texts.zh:
亲爱的[owner.GetName]，

我们代表弥那玛特种实业集团就债务未偿还一事与您进行联系。鉴于我们也是新近崛起的太空社会中的一员，我们理解您或许无法承担全部债务。我们的目的是帮助您选择一种适当的还款计划，在不阻碍经济发展的情况下偿还所有未偿还债务。

相应地，我们很高兴为您提供一名咨询顾问，免费！我们热切地希望这个问题能够顺利解决。
texts.en:
Dear [owner.GetName],

We are contacting you on behalf of the Minamar Specialized Industries regarding an outstanding debt. Being a fledging space-faring society, we understand you may not be in a position to repay the full amount. Our aim is to aid you in selecting an appropriate repayment plan, one which will settle any outstanding debts without stifling economic growth.

Accordingly, we are happy to offer you a consultation, free of charge! It is our ardent wish that this matter can be settled amicably.

label.zh: 我们很乐意协商解决问题。

responses.zh:
在我们的族人第一次触及星辰之前，我们就知道每个人在这个宇宙都有自己要扮演的角色。有些文化渴望力量。而另一些文化追求知识。我们进化是为了提供人情服务。

如果一个人从未因无私奉献而感到喜悦，那么此人错过了生命的主旨。弯腰鞠躬并不是自降身份，而是提升周围的人。
responses.en:
Even before our people first reached the stars, we understood that everyone has a role to play in this galaxy. Some cultures crave power. Others pursue knowledge. We evolved to favor service.

The one who has never felt the joy of unselfish service has missed the very theme of life. To bow down is not to be diminished. It is to uplift those around you.

texts.zh: 根据我们先前提交的估值，你亏欠我们客户的总额等于£energy£ [owner.debt_collectors_amount]能量币。我们非常乐意提供给你各种各样的偿还计划。
texts.en: According to the estimations we previously submitted, the amount you owe to our client is equal to £energy£ [owner.debt_collectors_amount] Energy Credits. We are happy to offer you a variety of repayment plans.

responses.zh: 你们想要一次结清债务的积极态度让我们感动不已，但仔细检查之后，你方提供的能量币看起来并不全是真货。想必，这只是单纯的产生了误解！让我们假装无事发生就好了。
responses.en: We are touched by your eagerness to settle your debt, but upon close examination, the energy credits you offered do not appear to be entirely genuine. Just a simple misunderstanding, we're sure! Let's pretend this never happened.

label.zh: 我们还能为您提供什么？
label.en: Anything else we can offer you?

texts.zh:
棒极了！很高兴我们能这么快就达成协议。我们将在15年后回来收第一笔分期付款，相信你们对这些条款感到很满意。

祝您有美好的一天！
texts.en:
Splendid! We are pleased we managed to reach an agreement so quickly. We will return in 15 years to collect the first installment and ensure you're happy with the terms.

Have a nice day!

tooltips.zh: 收债人将于[root.payback_debt_collectors_timer]返回。
tooltips.en: The debt collectors will return on [root.payback_debt_collectors_timer].

texts.zh:
收债人离开了我们的母星系，但一股深深的恐惧感至今依然在我们心中挥之不去。考虑到他们对于雇主尽心尽力，他们肯定不会停止对我们的骚扰。即使我们以某种方式偿还了全部债务，他们一定也会想出其它办法——利率、法律漏洞、隐藏在文档中的小字条款，藏在我们稀里糊涂签下的文件中。

如果我们无法回购自由，我们别无选择，只能为此而战。唯一的问题是该怎么做。
texts.en:
The debt collectors departed from our home system, but a deep sense of dread still linger. Given their dedication to their employer, they will never stop harassing us. Even if we somehow manage to repay the full sum, they will come up with something else - interest rates, legal loopholes, small print hidden in documents we don't remember signing.

If we can't buy back our freedom, we have no choice but to fight for it. The only question is how.

tooltips.zh: 我们将通过战争战胜MSI。
tooltips.en: We will triumph over the MSI through warfare.

tooltips.zh: 我们将通过外交手段战胜MSI。
tooltips.en: We will triumph over the MSI through diplomacy.

texts.zh: 我们击败了他们一次，我们就能再次这么做。但这并非易事——第一次，他们没有料到我们会还手。现在，他们将动用舰队的全部军力来攻击我们。要赢得一线机会，我们必须争取时间，做好准备。这是一场我们输不起的战斗。
texts.en: We defeated them once, and we can do it again. But it won't be easy - the first time, they weren't expecting for us to fight back. Now, they will attack us with the full might of their fleet. To have any chance, we must bide our time and prepare ourselves. This is a battle we cannot afford to lose.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以使用血债血偿宣战理由向MSI宣战了。
tooltips.en: We can now use the Payback casus belli to declare war to the MSI.

texts.zh:
弥那玛特种实业集团对我们的所作所为或许是合法的，但这些事情在道德上站不住脚。为了防止类似的事情再次发生，我们需要强硬的法律来让他们负责。通过谨慎的外交，我们可以尝试破坏维系他们帝国的原则：贪婪、剥削、奴役。如果我们幸运的话，我们可以不费一刀一枪就将MSI瓦解。

如果存在某个管理主体，我们就可以和想法类似的国家共同商讨这项事务……
texts.en:
What the Minamar Specialized Industries has done to us may have been legal, but it was far from moral. To prevent this from ever happening again, we need strong laws to hold them accountable. Through careful diplomacy, we can attempt to undermine the very principles that hold their empire together: greed, exploitation, slavery. With luck, we can destroy MSI without ever firing a shot.

If only there was some sort of governing body we could join to discuss this matter with like-minded empires...

Through careful diplomacy, we can attempt to undermine the very principles that hold their empire together: greed, exploitation, slavery. With luck, we can destroy MSI without ever firing a shot.

是时候让我们加入星海共同体了。

What the Minamar Specialized Industries has done to us may have been legal, but it was far from moral. To prevent this from ever happening again, we need strong laws to hold them accountable. Through careful diplomacy, we can attempt to undermine the very principles that hold their empire together: greed, exploitation, slavery. With luck, we can destroy MSI without ever firing a shot.

It's time for us to join the Galactic Community.

texts.en: [root.GetPaybackChainDescWords]

texts.zh:
这是我们的新战场：参议院，一个通过选举投票和辩论来解决冲突的战区。

这是我们的武器：外交支持、大使、我们经济的力量以及我们愿景的纯洁。

我们的目标：禁止启蒙行为，阻止像MSI这样的帝国剥削较弱的文明。

这就是我们获胜的地方。不是用暴力，而是用法律那不可动摇的力量。
texts.en:
Here is our new battlefield: the Senate floor, a war zone where conflicts are solved through vote-casting and debate.

Here are our weapons: favors, ambassadors, the strength of our economy and the purity of our vision.

Here is our goal: to ban enlightenment practices, preventing empires like the MSI from exploiting weaker civilizations.

Here is where we win. Not with violence, but through the immutable power of the law.

tooltips.zh: 我们将工作重心放在通过平等相待法案上，阻止帝国对前超光速文明进行剥削。为了确保法律执行，我们还需要支持所有4种制裁类型。
tooltips.en: We'll focus our efforts on passing the Equal Standing Act, preventing empires from exploiting pre-FTLs. We'll also need to support all 4 sanction types to enforce the law.

tooltips.zh: 我们将工作重心放在通过不予干涉法案上，防止帝国以任何方式影响前超光速社会的发展。为了确保法律执行，我们也需要通过全部4类制裁。
tooltips.en: We'll focus our efforts on passing the Non-Interference Act, preventing empires from influencing the development of pre-FTL societies in any way. We'll also need to pass all 4 sanction types to enforce the law.

亲爱的[owner.GetName]，

我们再次联系你，代表弥那玛特种实业集团商讨关于你们欠债的事。

根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴总额为5000£energy£能量币的费用来偿还你的债务。
texts.en:
Dear [owner.GetName],

Once again we're contacting you on the behalf of Minamar Specialized Industries regarding your outstanding debt.

As per our agreement, we are here to collect a sum equal to 5000 £energy£ Energy Credits for the repayment of your debt.

texts.en:

As per our agreement, we are here to collect a sum equal to 2500 £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods for the repayment of your debt.

texts.zh:

我们再次联系你，代表弥那玛特种实业集团商讨关于你们欠债的事。

根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴总额为1250£alloys£合金的费用来偿还你的债务。
texts.en:
Dear [owner.GetName],

Once again we're contacting you on the behalf of Minamar Specialized Industries regarding your outstanding debt.

As per our agreement, we are here to collect a sum equal to 1250 £alloys£ Alloys for the repayment of your debt.

texts.zh:
亲爱的[owner.GetName]，

我们再次联系你，代表弥那玛特种实业集团商讨关于你们欠债的事。

根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴愿意尽心尽力的劳动来偿还你债务的共计200£pop£人口。
texts.en:
Dear [owner.GetName],

Once again we're contacting you on the behalf of Minamar Specialized Industries regarding your outstanding debt.

As per our agreement, we are here to collect 200 £pop£ Pops willing to dedicate their labor to the repayment of your debt.

texts.zh:
亲爱的[owner.GetName]，

我们再次代表弥那玛特种实业集团就债务未偿一事与你联系。我们只希望和平解决此事，同时希望贵方更愿意参与建设性的对话。
texts.en:
Dear [owner.GetName],

Once again we're contacting you on behalf of the Minamar Specialized Industries regarding an outstanding debt. We only wish to resolve this matter peacefully, and hope that you are more willing to participate in a constructive dialogue.

texts.zh:
亲爱的[owner.GetName]，

这是我们的最后警告：你欠弥那玛特种实业集团的债务亟需偿还。尽管我们多次试图和平解决此事，你始终没有表达出合作的意愿。如果你再次拒绝执行偿还计划，我们将别无选择，只能采取所有必要的手段收缴你的资产。
texts.en:
Dear [owner.GetName],

This is our last warning: the debt you owe to the Minamar Specialized Industries urgently needs to be repaid. Despite multiple attempts to resolve this matter peacefully, you have consistently failed to cooperate. If you refuse once again to agree on a repayment plan, we will have no choice but to seize your assets by any means necessary.

label.zh: 我们很乐意协商解决问题。
这是你要求支付的款项。
label.en: Here is the payment you requested.

label.zh: 这是你要求支付的款项。
label.en: Here is the payment you requested.

label.zh: 这是你要求支付的款项。
label.en: Here is the payment you requested.

tooltips.zh: 失去200£pop£人口
tooltips.en: Lose 200 £pop£ Pops

tooltips.zh: 失去200£pop£奴隶
tooltips.en: Lose 200 £pop£ Slaves

label.zh: 抱歉，能再说一遍你是谁吗？

responses.zh:
在我们的族人第一次触及星辰之前，我们就知道每个人在这个宇宙都有自己要扮演的角色。有些文化渴望力量。而另一些文化追求知识。我们进化是为了提供人情服务。

如果一个人从未因无私奉献而感到喜悦，那么此人错过了生命的主旨。弯腰鞠躬并不是自降身份，而是提升周围的人。
responses.en:
Even before our people first reached the stars, we understood that everyone has a role to play in this galaxy. Some cultures crave power. Others pursue knowledge. We evolved to favor service.

The one who has never felt the joy of unselfish service has missed the very theme of life. To bow down is not to be diminished. It is to uplift those around you.

texts.zh: 感谢你的及时回应，以及你公平地解决此事的意愿！现在未偿还款项总额为[owner.debt_collectors_amount]£energy£能量币。我们将在15年后再回来，收下一笔分期款项。祝您愉快！
texts.en: Thank you for your prompt response and your willingness to settle the matter equitably! The outstanding sum is now equal to [owner.debt_collectors_amount] £energy£ Energy Credits. We will be back in 15 years to collect the next installment. Have a nice day!

label.zh: 未偿款项比预期的要高。
label.en: The outstanding sum is higher than expected.

texts.zh: 正如这个小字条款所标明的，我们执行的是标准利率。如果你继续按现有分期方式支付，你就能在29637年后偿清你的债务。
texts.en: As indicated in the small print, standard interest rates are applied. If you continue with your payments at the current rate, you will be able to repay your debt in exactly 29,637 years.

texts.zh:
我们很遗憾你们没能在商定时间内筹措到足够的款项。我们已经调整了你们的还款计划，减少了下次分期偿还的所需金额。

不幸的是，由于你方无法偿还债务，造成了违约。与之对应的，我们不得不扣押你们的一部分族人以代替资金。我们希望这么做不会造成不合时宜的不便。

考虑当下情况，我们有必要告知您，我们的客户也接受以工作时长为形式的偿付。你们的一些人口将会被运送到指定的工作地点，提供基础食宿，直到他们成功地偿还了债务。

值得注意的是，上述劳工不需要有完整公民权。任何具有劳动能力的都可以。
texts.en:
We are saddened to learn you weren't able to collect the agreed amount in time. We have adjusted your repayment plan, halving the required sum for the next installment.

Unfortunately, your inability to pay puts you in breach of our contract. Accordingly, we will now seize a segment of your population in lieu of funds. We hope does not cause undue inconvenience.

Considering the situation, we feel compelled to inform you that our client also accepts repayment in the form of dedicated work hours. Some of your population will be transported to their designated job sites and provided with basic accommodation until they have successfully repaid the debt.

It's worth noting that these workers need not be full citizens of yours. Any able bodies will do.

label.zh: 我们不会让你抓走我们的人民。
label.en: We won't let you take our people.

tooltips.zh: 收债人会攻击我们。
tooltips.en: The debt collectors will attack us.

responses.zh: 正确的术语是“契约仆人”。奴隶制是一种不公平的做法，依靠的是利用现存的权力结构进行剥削。我们的交易完全基于合约条款。
responses.en: The correct term is "indentured servants". Slavery is an unfair practice based on exploitation of pre-existing power structures. Our exchanges are based solely on the terms of contract.

texts.zh: 我们恳请你重新考虑一下你的决定。如果你拒绝付款，这将会在你的信用分数上留下一个永久的印记。拖欠债务会限制你未来的经济机遇，对于你自己的形象来说没有任何好处。你希望世人将你们当作这样的一个文明吗？通过唾弃那些愿意自降身份提升你们的人？
texts.en: We beg you to rethink your decision. Your refusal to pay will leave a permanent mark on your credit score. Defaulting will limit your financial opportunities in the future, to say nothing of your own self-image. Is this how you wish to be known as a society? By spitting on those who kneeled to lift you up?

texts.zh: 我们意识到你方拒绝偿还债务是一件令人十分担忧的事情。我们的客户，弥那玛特种实业集团，提供给你的全是帮助和支持，所求的仅仅只是一笔公平的款项作为交换。难道你们学到的东西就是这些？用友善温和换来的竟是阴险欺诈？
texts.en: We find the refusal to repay your debt deeply concerning. Our client, the Minamar Specialized Industries, offered you nothing but help and support, and only asked for a fair repayment in exchange. Is this all you have learned? To reciprocate kindness with deceit?

tooltips.zh: 收债人会攻击我们。
tooltips.en: The debt collectors will attack us.

label.zh: 让我们重新考虑一下我们的选择……

texts.zh:
如果你无法或不愿意支付能量币，你可以向弥那玛特种实业集团提供一定比例的劳动力储备来抵扣你的债务。你的工人将被送往指定工作场所，并获得基本食宿，直到他们成功偿还债务。

值得注意的是，上述劳工不需要有完整公民权。任何具有劳动能力的都可以。
texts.en:
If you are unable or unwilling to cover the energy cost, you may repay your debt by pledging a certain percentage of your labor pool to Minamar Specialized Industries. Your workers will be transported to their designated job sites and will be provided with basic accommodation until they have successfully repaid the debt.

It's worth noting that said workers do not need to be full citizens. Any able bodies will do.

label.zh: 实际上，我们更愿意用能量币支付。
label.en: Actually, we'd prefer to pay using energy.

tooltips.zh: 承诺下次收债人返回时给出200£pop£人口。
tooltips.en: Pledge to give 200 £pop£ Pops to the debt collectors upon their return.

responses.zh: 正确的术语是“契约仆人”。奴隶制是一种不公平的做法，依靠的是利用现存的权力结构进行剥削。我们的交易完全基于合约条款。
responses.en: The correct term is "indentured servants". Slavery is an unfair practice based on exploitation of pre-existing power structures. Our exchanges are based solely on the terms of contract.

texts.zh: 我们真的很抱歉，因为我们没能在这个问题上达成一致。你是否有机会再重新考虑一下？根据合约的条款，如果债务国不愿意或无法偿还，我们就必须代表客户收缴资产。
texts.en: We are truly sorry that we were unable to reach an agreement in this matter. Is there any chance you would be willing to reconsider? According to the terms of the contract, if a debtor is unwilling or unable to pay, we are required to seize assets on behalf of our client.

tooltips.zh: 收债人会攻击我们。
tooltips.en: The debt collectors will attack us.

label.zh: 让我们重新考虑一下我们的选择……

texts.zh: 与外星侵略者的战斗使我们的母星系充满了残骸、破碎的战舰和背弃的诺言。大量的废弃物料散布其中，使得从[owner.capital_scope.GetName]研发卫星和发射宇宙飞船变得更加困难。得益于清理计划的提出，专门设计的工程船可以用网在近地轨道上进行清理，让我们逐渐打通去往那艘仍漂浮在我们首都上空的MSI战舰的路线。
texts.en: The battle against the alien invaders left our home system full of debris, shattered warships, and broken promises. The sheer amount of flotsam cluttering the area has made it harder to develop satellites and to launch spaceships from [owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Under the proposed cleanup project, specially-designed construction ships will utilize nets to dredge the space in near-orbit, allowing us to approach the MSI warship that still looms over our capital.

texts.zh: 与外星侵略者的战斗使我们的母星系充满了残骸、破碎的战舰和背弃的诺言。大量的废弃物料散布其中，使得从[owner.capital_scope.GetName]研发卫星和发射宇宙飞船变得更加困难。得益于清理计划的提出，专门设计的工程船可以用网在近地轨道上进行清理，让我们逐渐打通去往那艘仍漂浮在我们首都上空的MSI战舰的路线。
texts.en: The battle against the alien invaders left our home system full of debris, shattered warships, and broken promises. The sheer amount of flotsam cluttering the area has made it harder to develop satellites and to launch spaceships from [owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Under the proposed cleanup project, specially-designed construction ships will utilize nets to dredge the space in near-orbit, allowing us to approach the MSI warship that still looms over our capital.

texts.zh: 我们星系中的清理工程正在顺利进行中。[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上空的碎片数量大幅减少了。随着天空逐渐明晰，我们的未来也变得越来越光明。工作仍在继续，一切都在向好的方向发展。
texts.en: The cleanup operation in our system is well underway. The amount of debris over [owner.capital_scope.GetName] has been significantly reduced, and with clearing skies, our expectations for the future are also bright. Work continues, but things are looking better.

texts.zh: 清理工作已经大功告成了。穿过这一片没有碎片的天空，我们的科研船就可以靠近战舰并安全地开始探索残骸。
texts.en: The cleanup operation is now complete. With our skies free from debris, our science ships are now able to approach the warship and safely explore the wreck.

texts.zh: 在[from.GetName]清理舰船残骸时，找到了一箱科技数据。
texts.en: While clearing the ship debris on [from.GetName], a cache of technological data was recovered.

texts.zh: 在[from.GetName]清理出的舰船残骸可以回收利用。
texts.en: The ship debris cleared on [from.GetName] can be repurposed for our own use.

texts.zh: 同我们前入侵者的会面促使我们的政坛领袖、宗教人士、科学家、艺术家和外交官之间举行了一场紧急会议。各界人士纷纷就各种战略进行讨论、否定、重新论证、改进、投票表决。经过几个月的高强度磋商，我们帝国最聪明的头脑已经达成了类似于共识的东西。
texts.en: The sighting of our former invaders has prompted an emergency meeting between political leaders, religious figures, scientists, artists, and diplomats. Strategies have been discussed, rejected, reconsidered, improved, voted on. After months of tense consultations, the brightest minds of our empire have reached something resembling a consensus.

label.zh: 我们会让他们瞧瞧，这里谁才是老大！
我们要求对等沟通交流。
label.en: We'll demand to be treated as equals.

label.zh: 我们会让他们就过去的所作所为做出赔偿！
label.en: We'll make them pay for what they did to us!

label.zh: 我们不愿同他们产生进一步的冲突。
label.en: We seek no further conflict with them.

label.zh: 我们不希望同异种产生交流。
label.en: We desire no further contact with xenos.

label.zh: 我们不能让恐惧阻止自己探索星海的步伐。
label.en: We can't let fear stop us from exploring the galaxy.

label.zh: 信徒的试炼必须要进行处理。
label.en: The trials of the faithful must be dealt with in turn.

label.zh: 我们希望研究他们。知己知彼。
label.en: We want to study them. Know your enemy.

texts.zh: 尽管采取了一些安管措施，我们与弥那玛特种实业集团发生遭遇的新闻依然传播给了公众，给这个刚刚开始从苦痛的过往中恢复过来的行星造成了不小的混乱。公众舆论……难以统一：有许多持不同看法的声音，从出离的愤怒到不怀好意的怀旧之情。无论我们作出什么样的决策，都会需要一定的暴力阻力。
texts.en: Despite security measures, news of our encounter with the Minamar Specialized Industries is spreading to the public, bringing chaos to a planet that was just beginning to recover from its past. Public opinion is... Fragmented: many dissenting voices, expressing everything from rage to ill-aimed nostalgia. Regardless of the decision, our actions will be met with violence.

label.zh: 他们有权表达自己的观点。
label.en: They have the right to express their views.

texts.zh: 经过长时间的周密准备，我们的特使已经向MSI呈递了一条信息。我们已经准备好按照自己的条件会见前主人，为我们人民的意愿发声。
texts.en: After extended preparations, our envoys have sent a message to the MSI. We are ready to meet our former masters on our terms, giving voice to the will of our people.

texts.zh: 收债人的舰队被迫撤退。他们毫无疑问还会回来的，但至少目前我们安全了。
texts.en: The debt collector fleet has been forced to retreat. They will doubtlessly return, but for now, we are safe.

texts.zh: 再一次，我们迫使收债人撤离了我们的母星系。这或许不太可能是我们最后一次和他们打交道，但至少我们的子民和财产目前又安全了。
texts.en: Once again, we forced the debt collectors to retreat from our home system. It's unlikely we've seen the last of them, but for now, our people and our assets are safe.

tooltips.zh: 收债人将于[root.payback_debt_collectors_timer]返回。
tooltips.en: The debt collectors will return on [root.payback_debt_collectors_timer].

texts.zh:
我们对此感到极度失望。

作为一家专精于启发那些欠发展文明的公司，我们因我们的专业才干而自豪。但很明显，我们未能传授一些最基础的知识。你们不能无缘无故地攻击其他人，而应该为你们的失败承担责任。

你们显然需要额外的指导。让我们来教你们如何偿还债务。
texts.en:
The disappointment is heavy.

As a company specializing in the enlightenment of less developed civilizations, we pride ourselves in our expertise. Yet it has become abundantly clear that we have failed to impart some basic lessons. Rather than attacking others without cause, you alone must bear the responsibility for your failures.

You are clearly in need of additional guidance. Let us teach you how to repay a debt.

label.zh: 我们绝不会再向你们低头！
label.en: We'll never bow to you again.

texts.zh: 在我们的舰队被击败后，收债人突袭了[PLANET.GetName]，绑架了我们的许多族人。比起这次战败更加令人心痛的，是他们留下的“账单”，告诉我们这些被扣押的人们将被用来偿还我们的“债务”。收债人说，我们应该心怀感恩，债务清算后我们的族人就能回家。还债时间大约只要29637年左右。
texts.en: After our fleet was defeated, the debt collectors raided [PLANET.GetName], kidnapping a number of our people. Even more galling than the defeat was the 'invoice' they left behind, informing us that the seized population will be put to work to repay our 'debt.' We should be grateful, the collectors say, that our people will be returned once the debt is settled. This should only take 29,637 years or so.

label.zh: 下一次我们会做好准备。
label.en: Next time we will be ready.

tooltips.zh:
收债人夺走500£pop£人口。

收债人将于[root.owner.payback_debt_collectors_timer]回来。
tooltips.en:
Lost 500 £pop£ Pops to the Debt Collectors.

The debt collectors will return on [root.owner.payback_debt_collectors_timer].

texts.zh: 我们清单上的第一项议案已经通过。我们阻碍弥那玛特种实业集团的计划目前正全力推进。
texts.en: The first resolution on our list has passed. Our plan to hinder the Minamar Specialized Industries is now in full motion.

texts.zh: 通过艰苦奋斗和坚毅决心，我们赢得了参议院的主导权，对前超光速文明的启蒙行为进行了限制，并且对违反这类规定的帝国实施了严厉的制裁。要想生存下来，MSI必须全盘颠覆式地重新思考他们的商业战略——他们帝国内部不安定的消息已经开始传播。
texts.en: Through hard work and determination, we have dominated the Senate Floor, restricting enlightenment practices and enforcing harsh sanctions against those empires which breach them. The MSI will have to radically rethink their business strategy to survive - and news of instability within their empire have already starting to spread.

texts.zh: 通过艰苦奋斗和坚毅决心，我们赢得了参议院的主导权，对前超光速文明的启蒙行为进行了限制，并且对违反这类规定的帝国实施了严厉的制裁。MSI已经消亡了——多亏了我们的辛勤运作，没有其他帝国会取代它们的地位。
texts.en: Through hard work and determination, we have dominated the Senate Floor, restricting enlightenment practices and enforcing harsh sanctions against those empires which breach them. The MSI is already gone - and thanks to our work, no other empire will ever replace them.

texts.zh:
致全体前客户的一封重要讯息：

自该公司第一次踏上星空的那一天起，我们就一直致力于改善其他文明，勤勉地帮助他们实现完全的潜能。经过数年的成功，董事会决定简化我们的流程，以更好反映我们公司的价值观。

相应地，我们已经暂时停止了文明启蒙活动，以便更好地将主要精力聚焦在品牌重塑上。

我们将在弥那玛特种实业集团开启勇于进取的全新篇章，感谢您的继续支持！
texts.en:
An important message to all our former clients:

From the day this company first reached the stars, we have dedicated ourselves to the betterment of other civilizations, diligently working to help them ascend to their full potential. After many successful years, the Board of Directors has made the decision to streamline our processes in order to better reflect our company values.

Accordingly, we have temporarily ceased our enlightenment activities to better focus on rebranding.

As we embark on a bold new chapter at Minamar Specialized Industries, we thank you for your continued support!

texts.zh:
甚至在我们踏上星空之前，我们就已经知道自己并不孤单。几个世纪以来，弥那玛特种实业集团一直悬于我们的头顶上——最初作为一个导师，后来又作为一个压迫者，如今到头来成为了一位堕落的暴君。

我们应该庆祝。然后，也许我们应该放下武器，最终开始休养生息。
texts.en:
Even before we reached the stars, we knew we were not alone. For centuries, the Minamar Specialized Industries has loomed over us - first as a mentor, then as an oppressor, and now finally as a fallen tyrant.

We should celebrate. And then, perhaps, we should lay down our weapons and finally rest.

label.zh: 我们的事业仍值得为之进行斗争。
label.en: Our cause is still worth fighting.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以利用惩罚宣战理由，向那些仍在剥削前超光速文明的国家发动战争。
tooltips.en: We can now use the Punishment casus belli to wage war against those who exploit pre-FTL civilizations.

texts.zh: 复仇之后是什么呢？你已经目睹了天敌的陨落，那个应对灭亡你的天敌而负责的国家也因为你而陨落了。现在又该怎么办？我们现在能放下武器吗？我们能和平相处吗？
texts.en: What comes after revenge? What to do after witnessing the fall of your nemesis, and of the empire responsible for killing your nemesis? Can we lay down our weapons now? Can we be at peace?

label.zh: 除非所有的剥削者都消亡，否则我们没法安息。
label.en: There will be no peace until all exploiters are gone.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以利用惩罚宣战理由，向那些仍在剥削前超光速文明的国家发动战争。
tooltips.en: We can now use the Punishment casus belli to wage war against those who exploit pre-FTL civilizations.

texts.zh:
当我们第一次与[bsempire.GetName]接触时，我们曾惊叹于他们破译我们语言的速度。我们现在理解了原因。

当我们的前主人试图让我们屈服的时候，他们绑架了我们的人民。其中一些不幸的人被带上了一艘MSI飞船。在孤注一掷的下，他们与船上的其他“契约奴隶”发动了兵变。他们在一颗无人居住的行星上进行了迫降，这次勇敢的反抗行为最终导致了[bsempire.GetName]的诞生。

我们拥有共同的敌人，以及共同的历史。或许，我们可以携手共建一个没有压迫的未来。
texts.en:
When we first made contact with the [bsempire.GetName], we marveled at the speed with which they deciphered our language. We now understand why.

When our former masters tried to bend us, they kidnapped our people. Some of these unfortunates wound up on an MSI ship. To their lasting credit, along with the other 'indentured assets' on board, they mutinied, crashing onto an uninhabited planet. This brave act of rebellion eventually resulted in the birth of the [bsempire.GetName].

We have a common enemy, and a shared history. And perhaps, together we can forge a future free from oppression.

label.zh: 也许这些异星人和我们并不完全是一模一样的。
label.en: Perhaps these xenos are not entirely unlike us.

texts.zh: 我们双方的帝国有一个共同的敌人：弥那玛特种实业集团。为了共同防范这个威胁，我们建议让他们的特工访问我们的机密情报。
texts.en: Our empires share a common enemy: the Minamar Specialized Industries. To protect ourselves against this threat, we suggest giving their operatives access to our classified intel.

label.zh: 共同的敌人并不能让我们加深友谊。
label.en: A common enemy doesn't make us friends.

texts.zh: [root.GetName]，我们在参议院看到了贵方特使。团结一致，我们可以为共同的事业进行奋斗。通过协调我们双方的利益，我们可以更好地服务于共同的事业，反对奴隶制，终结对前超光速文明的干涉行为。
texts.en: We see your envoys on the Senate Floor, [root.GetName]. Together, we we can fight for causes that affect us both. By aligning our interests, we can make common cause against slavery and end the practice of interfering with pre-FTL empires.

label.zh: 我们的利益并不总是一致。

texts.zh: 我们听说了你打算对弥那玛特种实业集团开战的计划。尽管我们人民拥有共同的历史，但我们并不认同你对复仇的渴望。不过，如果你对MSI宣战，我们也会加入你的事业。
texts.en: We have heard about your plans to make war on the Minamar Specialized Industries. Although our people share a common history, we do not share your thirst for revenge. However, should you declare war against MSI, we will join your cause.

texts.zh: 在MSI，我们将自己的客户视作家人。今天，我们不由得感到骄傲。击杀了一只星神兽！对于一个新生的太空文明，这是一个重要的里程碑。为了象征我们对你们成就的尊敬，请收下我们送来的这份小礼物。
texts.en: At MSI, we see our clients like family. Today, we can't help but feel proud. Slaying a Guardian! An important milestone for a fledgling space-faring society. As a token of our esteem for your accomplishment, please accept this small congratulatory gift from us.

texts.zh:
“我们要终结疾病。”

这就是入侵者们赢得我们的方式。我们允许他们在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上建造基因诊所，在一代人的时间里根除了绝大多数最要命的疾病。然而现在，这些诊所正在停摆，多年的高强度使用导致里面的机器陷入了停滞状态。我们无法得知这些入侵者的先进技术是如何正常运作的。我们能否对其进行逆向工程？或者我们应该把这个有毒的礼物改造成某种真正属于我们的东西？
其他国家可能也有类似的设施。我们应该开口求助。
texts.en:
"We are going to end illness."

That's how the invaders won us over. We allowed them to build Gene Clinics on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], eradicating most of our worst diseases within a generation. Now, those clinics are breaking down, years of intense use causing the machines within to grind to a halt. The proper functioning of the invader's technology is beyond us. Can we reverse-engineer it? Or should we repurpose this poisoned gift into something truly our own?
Other empires might possess similar facilities. We should ask for help.

尽管其他国家可能也有类似的设施，但是向异种求助无疑会让我族蒙羞。

Other empires might possess similar facilities, but asking the xenos for help would only bring us shame.

label.en: Attempt to repair the Gene Clinics.

tooltips.zh: 在行星面板上选择基因诊所，点击修复按钮尝试对其修复。同其他国家签署科研协议能够提高成功修复的概率。
tooltips.en: Select the Gene Clinics on the planetary view screen and click the repair button to attempt a fix. Establishing research agreements with other empires will increase our chances of success.

tooltips.zh: 将基因诊所转变成一座长眠庇护所，花费会有所减少。
tooltips.en: Turn the Gene Clinics into a Sanctuary of Repose at a reduced cost.

tooltips.zh: 将基因诊所转变成一座先驱者纪念碑，花费会有所减少。
tooltips.en: Turn the Gene Clinics into an Autochthon Monument at a reduced cost.

texts.zh:
前入侵者为我们建造的基因诊所已经年久失修。其中的大部分科技超出了我们目前的认知，但我们还是可以试着修复一下。

与其他的帝国签订科研协议将会提高我们成功的概率。[GetAgreementStatus]
texts.en:
The Gene Clinics our invaders built for us are suffering from lack of maintenance. While most of the technology is beyond our current understanding, we could try to repair it.

Signing research pacts with other empires will increase our chances of success. [GetAgreementStatus]

texts.zh: 我们的基因诊所可能不再能够治愈疾病，但是通过将一些关键部件拆卸下来，并将其重新用于纪念馆的展出，至少我们能够开始治愈入侵者留下的疤痕。与过去和解，我们才能逐渐克服这一切。
texts.en: Our Gene Clinics may no longer have the power to cure disease, but by stripping them of their components and repurposing them into memorials, we can at least start to heal the scars left by the invaders. By making peace with the past, we can learn to overcome it.

texts.zh: 由于我们失去了基因诊所，医疗保障的质量急剧下降。曾经很容易治愈的遗传病和慢性病病例又开始上升，我们的预期寿命中位数返回到了占领前的水平。公众对医疗保障系统的信心已经达到了新的低点，我们中的一些人甚至开始感叹，入侵者走了不如不走。
texts.en: The loss of our Gene Clinics has precipitated a sharp decline in the quality of our healthcare. Genetic conditions and chronic illnesses that were once simple to cure are again on the rise, and our median life expectancy has returned to pre-occupation levels. Public faith in the healthcare system has reached a new low, and some of our people are even starting to lament the departure of the invaders.

label.zh: 在医疗研究方面加倍投入。
label.en: Double our investment in medical research.

tooltips.zh: 提高发现基因健康保障科技的可能性。
tooltips.en: Increases the likelihood of discovering Genetic Healthcare technology.

tooltips.zh: 这没什么卵用。
tooltips.en: This will do nothing.

label.zh: 死亡对我们来说从来不是问题。
label.en: Death has never been a problem for us.

texts.zh: 我们的前入侵者或许会将这一切视作来去无踪的狗屎运，或者宣称修复工作是由他们主导的。他们甚至会说，我们所做的对基因诊所背后的技术进行逆向工程压根就不是什么壮举。但不管他们说什么，在慷慨的盟友派出的专家的帮助下，我们都完成了。
texts.en: Our former invaders would likely wave it off as a stroke of luck, or argue that they did most of the work. They would claim it's not a big feat, to retro-engineer the technology behind the Gene Clinics as we just did. But we did it anyway, supported by the expertise of our generous allies.

texts.zh: 我们的前入侵者或许会将这一切视作来去无踪的狗屎运，或者宣称修复工作是由他们主导的。他们甚至会说，我们所做的对基因诊所背后的技术进行逆向工程压根就不是什么壮举。但不管他们说什么，我们都自主独立地完成了，没有他们的任何协助，这下胜利独属于我们了。
texts.en: Our former invaders would likely wave it off as a stroke of luck, or argue that they did most of the work. They would claim it's not a big feat, to retro-engineer the technology behind the Gene Clinics as we just did. But we did it anyway, without their assistance, and the triumph is ours alone.

texts.zh: 我们能够自己照顾自己。
texts.en: We can take care of ourselves.

label.zh: 或许……外星人也不全都是那么坏？
label.en: Perhaps... the Xenos aren't all bad?

tooltips.zh: 约5%£pop£人口获得亲外主义思潮。
tooltips.en: Approximately 5% of our £pop£ Pops gain the Xenophile ethic.

texts.zh: 事实证明，要想对使基因诊所运转的技术进行逆向工程，这件事比我们料想的更具挑战性。但我们的[root.GetEngineerPlural]仍然充满希望。他们说，自己只是需要更多的时间。然而，随着成本和失败开始堆积，一些人认为应当对诊所进行改造，使其用于另一项事务。
texts.en: Reverse engineering the technology powering the Gene Clinics turned out to be more challenging than expected, but our [root.GetEngineerPlural] remain hopeful. They just need more time, they say. But as costs and failures start piling up, some argue the clinics should be retrofitted to suit a different purpose.

label.zh: 这次没那么容易失败了。

tooltips.en: Turn the Gene Clinics into an Autochthon Monument at a reduced cost.

texts.zh:
我们尝试维修基因诊所的努力最终失败了：巨大的爆炸吞没了建筑，现场死伤惨重。

无疑，前入侵者一定正在嗤嗤嘲笑我们的自大、愚蠢和鲁莽。这次失败我们咎由自取，但这堂课我们也同样印象深刻。
texts.en:
Our attempt to repair the Gene Clinics ended in failure: a massive explosion engulfed the building, and numerous casualties have been reported.

No doubt our former invaders are laughing, calling us arrogant, foolish, unprepared. Yet this failure belongs to us, and its hard lessons will not be forgotten.

texts.zh: 在掌握了基因工程的奥秘之后，我们的人民现在有能力建造基因诊所，其能力水平同入侵者先前留下来的那些一模一样。对我们的人民来说，这是极其光荣的一天：证明我们无需[root.species.GetHandName]的把控，也能触及星辰。
texts.en: Having mastered the secrets of genetic engineering, our people are now able to build Gene Clinics like the ones left by the invaders. It's a glorious day for our people: proof that we need no [root.species.GetHandName]-holding to reach the stars.

texts.zh: 最近我们在舰船设计方面有所进步，使我们对升级旗舰、利用以前未使用的系统有了深入了解。
texts.en: Recent advancements in our ship designs have led to an insight in how to upgrade our flagship to make use of previously unused systems.

tooltips.zh: 开启一项升级旗舰的特殊项目。
tooltips.en: Enables a Special Project to upgrade the flagship.

texts.zh: 技术的最新进展使得我们能够改装旗舰，用上一些以前未使用过的系统。
texts.en: Recent advances in our technology will allow us to refit our flagship to make use of some previously unused systems.

texts.zh: 我们已经升级了旗舰。利用船上现有的技术，我们能够对它的系统进行逆向工程，以获得对飞船内部运作更好的了解。
texts.en: We have upgraded the flagship. Utilizing the existing technology onboard, we have been able to reverse-engineer its systems and gain a better understanding of the inner workings of the vessel.

tooltips.zh: 我们的旗舰已经升级，可以利用以前未使用的系统。
tooltips.en: Our flagship has been upgraded to make use of previously unused systems.

texts.zh: 席卷而过的宇宙风暴留下了一份奇怪的礼物：一座属于老旧居住站系统的轨道复合体。登陆之后有可能加以激活。
texts.en: The passing cosmic storm left behind a curious present: an orbital complex from an old habitat system. Boarding may allow us to reactivate it.

sections.zh: 席卷而过的宇宙风暴留下了一份奇怪的礼物：一座属于老旧居住站系统的轨道复合体。登陆之后有可能加以激活。
sections.en: The passing cosmic storm left behind a curious present: an orbital complex from an old habitat system. Boarding may allow us to reactivate it.

texts.zh:
尽管这座轨道复合体被宇宙风暴拖拽着漂星过海，但它似乎没怎么受到损伤。我们发现居住站中的居住和商业空间几乎状态完好。这些区域一尘不染，仿佛从未有人使用过一般。

在中控室中迎接我们的是一个令人眼花缭乱的输入系统：各种没有任何说明的刻度盘，设置不一的拉杆，大量的按钮以看似随机的间隔五颜六色地闪烁着。幸运的是，我们最终找到了一本手册。相信只要成功翻译出来，我们就可以重新激活这座居住站了。
texts.en:
Despite having been dragged across the galaxy by the cosmic storm, the orbital complex suffered very little harm. We found the living and commercial spaces of the habitat in almost perfect condition. Not a single bit of dust laid atop the surface that would betray a previous occupancy, as if it had never before been used.

Inside the central control hub we were greeted by a bewildering input system: dials with no explanation, levers with inconsistent settings and a great amount of buttons flashing a whole spectrum of colors at seemingly random intervals. Fortunately, we eventually came across a manual. Once this is successfully translated, we are confident we can reactivate the habitat.

texts.zh:
不幸的是，我们之前的估计过于乐观了：翻译出来的手册和这个控制系统一样令人无法理解。不仅缺失了一半的页面，图片说明上有着大量的符号学设定，而且另一半手册则是用一种难以破译的象形文字书写的。

然而，最后一页展示了一个通讯频率并附有一组可翻译成“帮助台”的字符。我们现在正尝试联络这个频率。
texts.en:
Unfortunately, our previous estimation appears to have been optimistic: the manual turned out to be just as incomprehensible as the control system. Half of the pages appeared to be missing and the pictorial instructions make significant semiotic assumptions. The other half of the manual is written in difficult to interpret hieroglyphs.

However, the last page displayed a com frequency accompanied by a set of characters translated to 'help desk'. We're attempting this frequency now.

title.zh: 您的来电对我们很重要
title.en: Your Call is Important To Us

texts.zh:
手册中的通讯频道连接到了一个名为“天空花园”的商业实体的帮助台主机。

助手人工智能用一种友好而中立的语气告诉我们，它感谢我们的联系，并询问是否有什么可以帮得上忙的。列出的选项包括“回答有关订阅的问题”、“了解新的智能防御系统”，以及我们是否希望更多地了解该公司的“社会责任倡议”。

然而，随后的选项把我们引向越来越不相关的话题。更糟的是，它还经常会让我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]等待，然后切断通讯。显然，这个人工智能服务并没有像居住站的其他部分一样经受住时间的考验。

无论如何，我们将继续按自己的方法来试着搞定这个神秘的系统。
texts.en:
The manual's com frequency connected us to the help desk mainframe of a commercial entity known as Skygarden.

With a friendly though neutral tone, the help desk AI informed us that it appreciated our reaching out, and asked if there was anything it could aid us with. Among the listed options were 'answering questions about subscriptions', 'learning about the new line of smart defense systems' and if we wished to know more about the corporation's 'social responsibility initiatives'.

However, the subsequent options continued to direct us to entirely unrelated topics. Worst of all, it would often put our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on hold only to drop the call. Obviously, the service AI has not survived the passing of time as well as the rest of the habitat.

Nevertheless, we will continue trying to find our way through this arcane system.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]汇报，无论他们和人工智能说什么，在几分钟的等待过去后，这个系统都只会复读之前的内容。

我们尝试运行多个模拟来绘制精确的菜单树，但是却发生了递归错误，并且无法同时解决和检查解决方案。即使运行量子模型也没有得到理想的结果。我们怀疑在这个过程中我们不小心破坏了一些波函数。

我们不知所措了。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] report that regardless of what they said to the AI, after passing through several menus, the system would simply revert back to a previous statement.

We attempted to run several simulations to map out the exact menu tree, but our efforts returned recursive errors and an inability to both solve and check the solution at the same time. Even running a quantum model achieved no desirable results. We suspect we accidentally collapsed a few wave functions in the process.

We're at a loss.

label.zh: 告诉这个人工智能它的违禁词被违禁词了。
label.en: Tell the AI it's CENSORED and CENSORED.

texts.zh:
终于有进展了！这个人工智能警告我们用语不当，并告知我们应该等待客户服务代表的联系。

我们等了一阵子之后，通讯频道又打开了。另一端的实体介绍她自己为天空花园公司的记录管理员。服务台本身是她从上一位记录管理员那里继承来的人工智能程序。据她所知，自从几十年前天空花园破产以来，这个通讯站就再没有使用过了。当我们问她为什么继续为一个破产的机构工作时，她只说这就是她的合同内容。

向记录管理员阐明了我们的情况后，她翻出了一本古老的居住站快速入门指南。她很快就会把书页的数字印痕传送给我们。
texts.en:
Finally a breakthrough! The AI admonished us for using inappropriate language and stated we should wait until we are contacted by a customer service representative.

For a while we were left waiting, and then the com line was reopened. The entity on the other end introduced herself as the record keeper of the Skygarden Corporation. The help desk itself was an AI program she had inherited from the last record keeper. As far as she knows, the com station had not been used since the bankruptcy of Skygarden many decades ago. When we questioned why she remained working for a bankrupt organization, she simply said it was in her contract.

Explaining our situation, the record keeper dug up an old quick start guide to the habitat. She will transfer digital impressions of the pages to us soon.

texts.zh:
终于有进展了！这个人工智能显然对于我们长时间的沉默感到困惑不解，并将会把我们转给客服代表。

我们等了一阵子之后，通讯频道又打开了。另一端的实体介绍她自己为天空花园公司的记录管理员。服务台本身是她从上一位记录管理员那里继承来的人工智能程序。据她所知，自从几十年前天空花园破产以来，这个通讯站就再没有使用过了。当我们问她为什么继续为一个破产的机构工作时，她只说这就是她的合同内容。

向记录管理员阐明了我们的情况后，她翻出了一本古老的居住站快速入门指南。她很快就会把书页的数字印痕传送给我们。
texts.en:
Finally a breakthrough! The AI was apparently confused at our prolonged silence and will refer us to a customer service representative.

For a while we were left waiting, and then the com line was reopened. The entity on the other end introduced herself as the record keeper of the Skygarden Corporation. The help desk itself was an AI program she had inherited from the last record keeper. As far as she knows, the com station had not been used since the bankruptcy of Skygarden many decades ago. When we questioned why she remained working for a bankrupt organization, she simply said it was in her contract.

Explaining our situation, the record keeper dug up an old quick start guide to the habitat. She will transfer digital impressions of the pages to us soon.

texts.zh:

我们等了一阵子之后，通讯频道又打开了。另一端的实体介绍她自己为天空花园公司的记录管理员。服务台本身是她从上一位记录管理员那里继承来的人工智能程序。据她所知，自从几十年前天空花园破产以来，这个通讯站就再没有使用过了。当我们问她为什么继续为一个破产的机构工作时，她只说这就是她的合同内容。

向记录管理员阐明了我们的情况后，她翻出了一本古老的居住站快速入门指南。她很快就会把书页的数字印痕传送给我们。
texts.en:
Finally a breakthrough! The AI admonished us for abusing the control panel and stated we should wait until we are contacted by a customer service representative.

For a while we were left waiting, and then the com line was reopened. The entity on the other end introduced herself as the record keeper of the Skygarden Corporation. The help desk itself was an AI program she had inherited from the last record keeper. As far as she knows, the com station had not been used since the bankruptcy of Skygarden many decades ago. When we questioned why she remained working for a bankrupt organization, she simply said it was in her contract.

Explaining our situation, the record keeper dug up an old quick start guide to the habitat. She will transfer digital impressions of the pages to us soon.

title.en: Years to Earn, Seconds to Lose

texts.zh:
有了新的指南后，重新启动居住站毫不费力。

在机器启动的声音慢慢平息后，我们决定再一次向记录员表示感谢。

她说在这个通讯台找到了一些信息，显然，这是五个多世纪前建造的原型，但在一场特别恶劣的宇宙风暴之后，迷失于混沌太空之中。财产损失和开发成本的打水漂就够让天空花园破产的了。

帮助我们是这位记录员多年来第一件有意义的服务。

“再说了，”她说。“我也很高兴能再次听到我曾祖母的声音，即使只是一个人工智能而已。”
texts.en:
With the new guide in our possession, restarting the habitat required little effort.

After the noise of activating machinery slowly died down, we decided to reach out to the record keeper once more to thank her.

She told us she had recovered some information on this station. Apparently it had been built over five centuries ago as a prototype, but was lost in the astrological chaos following a particularly nasty cosmic storm. The loss of property and development costs was enough to bankrupt Skygarden.

Helping us was the record keeper's first useful task in years.

"Besides," she said. "It was nice to hear my great-grandmother's voice on the line again, even it was just an AI."

texts.zh: 修复这艘坠毁的运奴船的电脑核心应该可以令我们找到自己母星的位置……同时也是弥那玛特种实业集团的母星。
texts.en: Repairing the computer core of the crashed slaver ship should reveal the location of our former home worlds... as well as Minamar Specialized Industries.

sections.zh: 修复这艘坠毁的运奴船的电脑核心应该可以令我们找到自己母星的位置……同时也是弥那玛特种实业集团的母星。
sections.en: Repairing the computer core of the crashed slaver ship should reveal the location of our former home worlds... as well as Minamar Specialized Industries.

texts.zh:
甚至在我们踏上星空之前，我们就已经知道自己并不孤单。几个世纪以来，弥那玛特种实业集团一直悬于我们的头顶上——最初作为一个导师，后来又作为一个压迫者，如今到头来成为了一位堕落的暴君。

我们应该庆祝。然后，也许我们应该放下武器，最终开始休养生息。
texts.en:
Even before we reached the stars, we knew we were not alone. For centuries, the Minamar Specialized Industries has loomed over us - first as a mentor, then as an oppressor, and now finally as a fallen tyrant.

We should celebrate. And then, perhaps, we should lay down our weapons and finally rest.

label.zh: 我们的事业仍值得为之进行斗争。
label.en: Our cause is still worth fighting.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以利用惩罚宣战理由，向那些仍在剥削前超光速文明的国家发动战争。
tooltips.en: We can now use the Punishment casus belli to wage war against those who exploit pre-FTL civilizations.

texts.zh:
甚至在我们踏上星空之前，我们就已经知道自己并不孤单。几个世纪以来，弥那玛特种实业集团一直悬于我们的头顶上——最初作为一个导师，后来又作为一个压迫者，如今到头来成为了一位堕落的暴君。现在MSI已经不复存在、被另一个[root.species.GetHandName]摧毁了。

我们的天空可能变得更加晴朗了，但我们的人民仍为永无止境的需求所占据，那便是：

复仇。
texts.en:
Even before we reached the stars, we knew we were not alone. For centuries, the Minamar Specialized Industries has loomed over us - first as a mentor, then as an oppressor, and now finally as a fallen tyrant. Now the MSI is gone, crushed by another [root.species.GetHandName].

Our skies may be clear, but our people are still possessed by an insatiable need:

Revenge.

label.zh: 我们的事业仍值得为之进行斗争。
label.en: Our cause is still worth fighting.

tooltips.zh: 我们将继续斗争，直到全宇宙禁止对前超光速文明进行剥削。
tooltips.en: We'll keep fighting to ban the exploitation of pre-FTLs.

label.zh: 他们偷走了我们的复仇。他们要为此付出代价。
label.en: They stole our revenge. They'll pay for it.

tooltips.zh: 我们现在可以使用血债血偿宣战理由向[destroyer_country.GetName]宣战了。
tooltips.en: We can now use the Payback casus belli to declare war to the [destroyer_country.GetName].

texts.zh:
多年前，我们给了你们一条通向天空的飞梯。今天，我们目睹了你们对一个低等文明提供了同样的帮助。

我们相信你们能把我们曾经的教导传授给他们。当然，如果你们需要帮助来起草一项有利可图的启蒙策略，你完全可以向我们咨询。
texts.en:
Years ago, we gave you a ladder to the sky. Today, we have witnessed you offer a lesser civilization the same help.

We trust you will be able to pass on our lessons to them. Of course, should you need any help in drafting a profitable enlightenment strategy, you have only to ask.

label.zh: 我们可以运用你的帮助。

texts.zh:
亲爱的前客户，

我们听说了你最近的经济困境。学习如何管理你的金融是运营一个帝国的必要部分，有些时候，失败也是学习的至关重要的一部分。

我们很乐意为你提供必须的资源，来让你的国家摆脱赤字。当然，出借的资源也将纳入你未偿还债务的一部分。我们希望这点小小的金融教训能对你有所帮助。
texts.en:
Dear former clients,

We heard about your recent economic troubles. Learning to manage your finances is a necessary part of running an empire, and sometimes, failure is an essential part of learning.

We are happy to offer you the necessary resources to put your country out of deficit. Of course, the cost loaned resources will be added to your outstanding debt. We hope this little financial lesson can be of help.

label.zh: 我们可以自己处理好自己的事。
label.en: We can manage it on our own.

texts.zh: 我们已经知道自己在宇宙中并非孤身一人。然而，我们却再次同另一个太空文明相遇了，这一事实让我们忧心忡忡。
texts.en: We already knew we were not alone in the universe. Yet, we found our second contact with another space-faring civilization unsettling.

texts.zh: 和我们一样，这些外星人显然也是差不过刚刚步入宇宙的大舞台，他们的科技水平也同我们相近。
texts.en: Just like us, the aliens appear to be relative newcomers on the galactic stage, and their level of technology is similar to our own.

texts.zh: 我们的科技发展水平远远超过了这些外星人。他们尚未具备星际航行的能力。
texts.en: Our technological development is far beyond that of these aliens. They have yet to become space-faring.

texts.zh: 这些外星人所创立的文明显然十分悠久，他们的科技水平将我们远远地甩在了身后。
texts.en: The civilization these aliens have built appears to be very old, and their level of technology is far beyond our own.

texts.zh: 我们知道，自己一定会再次找到曾经的主人。我们只是没有预料到会这么快就找到他们。
texts.en: We knew we were bound to find our former master again. We just weren't expecting to find them again so soon.

texts.zh: 他们的意图要比曾经作为我们主人的那些家伙要好太多了。或许我们只是在第一次同外星人遭遇的时候运气不太好。毕竟，宇宙这么大，总该有些好心肠。
texts.en: Their intentions seem far more benign than those of our former masters. Perhaps we were just unfortunate with our first alien encounter. After all, there must be some good in the galaxy.

texts.zh: 尽管他们与我们的前主人不尽相同，但却一样地令人可憎。我们开除怀疑是不是星系中其他所有的文明全部都是一肚子坏水。至于想交朋友，我们还不如自己待着。
texts.en: They are so different from our former masters, and yet so alike in their reproachable behavior. It makes us wonder if perhaps all other civilizations in the galaxy are riddled with ill will and poor intentions. In terms of friendship, we may just be alone.

texts.zh: 他们与我们如此不同，却又如此和蔼可亲。我们好奇这或许就是宇宙中还存在着好外星人的征兆，在繁星之间终究还是存在着一些善良的心的。
texts.en: They are so different from us. Yet they are so amicable. We wonder if perhaps this is a sign that there can indeed be good xenos out there. There may be kindness among the stars after all.

texts.zh: 他们可真不是宇宙中的什么好东西。我们以前没这么想真是太傻了！
texts.en: There truly are no good xenos in the cosmos. It was foolish of us to think otherwise!

texts.zh: 我们到底能不能逃离他们的魔爪？
texts.en: Will we ever be free from their grasp?
